articles.title: India hands over personal watercraft to Sri Lanka
articles.summary: India has handed over two personal watercraft (PWC) to the Sri Lankan Coast Guard, significantly enhancing their capabilities in near-shore Search and Rescue operations. This strategic move, announced by the Indian High Commission, strengthens bilateral maritime cooperation and supports Sri Lanka's defence infrastructure, reflecting India's commitment to regional security and fostering stronger ties with neighbouring nations.
